description: Gets one attachment of a Gmail message by the message ID and the attachment's part ID, both of which gmail_read lists for each attachment. Describes the attachment and, when it is text, returns that text. Every response carries the file name, MIME type, size in bytes and a current attachment ID. For a text attachment (plain text, CSV, JSON, XML, HTML, calendar files and similar) of up to 0.5 MB, the response also carries the content as text, cut at 200,000 characters with a marker saying how much was left out, and with characters that cannot be seen removed. For any other type, or a larger file, no content is returned: the response states the size and the reason, and the attachment ID it carries is the one gmail_save_attachment_to_drive takes to put the file in Drive, where drive_read_file reads Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. File bytes are not returned as base64 for any type.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

message_id.description: The ID of the message the attachment is on.

part_id.description: The attachment's part ID from gmail_read, such as "1" or "0.1". It is the attachment's place in the message and is the same on every read, where an attachment ID is issued new each time.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_get_attachment
